profiles.notes: The dedicated postgraduate admissions page supplies these general routes; faculties may add requirements. No entry year is specified. Requirements are not copied into individual programmes.

requirements.label: Master's eligibility
requirements.details: A good level-8 bachelor's degree averaging C (60–69%), or a good postgraduate diploma, from a recognized institution. Approved equivalent level-8 qualifications may be considered. Faculty conditions still apply, such as teaching experience for M.Ed.; the C band is not an upper score limit.

requirements.label: Postgraduate diploma eligibility
requirements.details: Normally an accredited bachelor's degree; exceptionally, faculty/department/institute-certified experience and accomplishments equivalent to that degree may be considered.

profiles.notes: General doctoral entry, not a programme-specific offer. The official page does not date the requirement.

requirements.label: Doctoral eligibility
requirements.details: A master's qualification, or equivalent, in the intended field from a recognized higher-education institution.

profiles.notes: Two distinct special doctoral routes, not normal first-year eligibility. Experience here is an admission condition, not graduate employment information.

requirements.label: Research master's upgrade
requirements.details: Bachelor's-only applicants may first enrol in a research-only master's; exceptional ability demonstrated during its first research year can permit consideration for doctoral upgrading.

requirements.label: Higher doctorate candidacy
requirements.details: UNAM graduates: bachelor's standing of 15+ years, master's 10+, or doctorate 8+. External graduates need 5+ years of approved UNAM academic service; the page's degree-standing cross-reference needs clarification. Only outstanding scholars with nationally and internationally recognized contributions are considered.

profiles.notes: General qualification pathways, subject to school-specific regulations. Certificate dates distinguish examination systems, not admission years. These are not IB scores; no programme-specific threshold is inferred.

requirements.label: Degree: pre-2021 certificates
requirements.details: Five distinct subjects: either 2 NSSCH at 4+ and 3 NSSCO at C+, or 3 NSSCH at 4+ and 2 NSSCO at D+. Both alternatives require NSSCO English C+; school regulations also apply.

requirements.label: Degree: certificates from 2021
requirements.details: Five distinct subjects: either 2 NSSCAS averaging d+ and 3 NSSCO at C+, or 3 NSSCAS averaging d+ and 2 NSSCO at D+. Both alternatives require NSSCO English C+; school regulations also apply.

requirements.label: Diploma: pre-2021 certificates
requirements.details: Five NSSCO subjects, or combined NSSCO/NSSCH: 24+ UNAM evaluation points and NSSCO English D+. School regulations apply.

requirements.label: Diploma: certificates from 2021
requirements.details: Five subjects: either 2 NSSCAS at e+ and 3 NSSCO at D+, or 5 NSSCO totalling 24+ UNAM evaluation points. NSSCO English D+ and school regulations apply.

requirements.label: Other school-leaving qualifications
requirements.details: Recognized alternatives undergo individual assessment using UNAM's evaluation scale.

profiles.notes: Prior tertiary qualification pathway; consideration is not guaranteed admission or credit transfer. The source does not identify an entry year within the programme.

requirements.label: Prior tertiary qualifications
requirements.details: Completed NQF-registered tertiary qualifications permit consideration: level 3/120+ credits for certificates; level 4/120+ for diplomas; level 5/240+ for degrees.

profiles.notes: The reviewed application-information page explicitly refers to 2026 undergraduate and postgraduate applications. Its 'open' announcement is not evidence that applications remain open today. These shared instructions are stored once; programme-specific and mature-age routes need their own review.

requirements.label: One online application
requirements.details: Submit one online form. Previous applicants reuse their student number; newcomers receive a reference/student number.

requirements.label: Choices and study mode
requirements.details: Specify your preferred programme, a second choice where applicable, and full-time or part-time study.

requirements.label: Selection after eligibility
requirements.details: Meeting minimum academic and applicable English requirements does not ensure an offer where places are competitive; eligible applications go to school admissions committees.

requirements.label: NQA evaluation
requirements.details: Qualifications completed outside UNAM require a recent NQA evaluation certificate before admission consideration. The page also explicitly requires this of international applicants.

requirements.label: Original documents at registration
requirements.details: Admitted applicants must present original documents on registration day, as directed in Registrar correspondence.

requirements.label: Assigned registration date
requirements.details: Fully admitted applicants register on their assigned school/department/programme date; missing it can forfeit the place or incur a late fee.

profiles.notes: An additional international-applicant document rule. The shared 2026 application instructions, including NQA evaluation, are in the All applicants scope and are not repeated here.

requirements.label: International certificate evidence
requirements.details: Supply the school-leaving certificate, or examination-authority confirmation that it will be issued during the first study year.
